badge_encrypted_explanation: Encrypted: opened with its password. Exporting writes an unencrypted copy unless you set a password.
badge_repaired_explanation: Repaired: the file was damaged and rebuilt on open. Exporting writes a repaired copy, never an incremental save onto the broken file.
badge_form_explanation: Has form: fields and values are kept on export; fields from different files are renamed by source when names collide.
badge_xfa_explanation: XFA: this form uses XFA, which is not supported. Exporting keeps the regular form fields and removes the XFA data.
badge_signed_explanation: Signed: exporting will invalidate the signature unless saved incrementally.
signature_badge_explanation: Signed: export writes a new file, which cannot keep the signature. See Signatures in the Inspector.
signature_explain_intact: The signed bytes match the signature, and it covers the whole file.
signature_explain_intact_changed_later: The signed version matches the signature; later sections of the file only add the changes listed below.
signature_explain_changed_after_signing: The signed version matches the signature, but later sections of the file change its content (listed below).
signature_explain_broken: The file does not match what was signed, or the signature does not cover what it claims.
signature_explain_cannot_check: This signature uses a format or algorithm this app cannot check.
signature_honesty: Checked on this device against the certificates in the file. Signer identity, trust and revocation are not verified.
signature_check_failed: The signatures could not be checked: {reason}
signature_chain_root: Ends at a root certificate included in the file (not trusted).
signature_chain_incomplete: Does not reach a root certificate included in the file.
signature_validity_detail: Signer certificate dates: {from} – {to}; compared with the claimed time and today.
signature_visual_changes: Pages that look different from the signed version: {pages}.
signature_view_failed: Could not open the signed version: {reason}
signature_version_unavailable: The signed version could not be read.
signature_view_notice: Signed version (revision {revision}) of {name}, opened for viewing. Changes made here do not affect the original file.
signature_export_notice: Export writes a new file: existing signatures are removed from it. The original file keeps them.
signature_export_notice_edited: You changed this signed file. Export writes a new file with your changes; existing signatures are removed from it, because a signature cannot survive a rewrite. The original file keeps them.
sign_dialog_description: The signature is added when the document is exported: an approval signature (PAdES-B) over the exported file. The certificate file and password stay in this tab’s memory and are dropped after the export.
sign_visible: Show the signature on a page
sign_visible_hint: A box with the signer’s name and the date. Without it the signature is invisible.
sign_signer_preview: Read from the certificate file. Nobody has verified this identity.
sign_refused_legacy: This certificate file uses legacy encryption (3DES or RC2), which cannot be opened here. Re-export it with AES-256, for example with OpenSSL (on Windows, choose “AES256-SHA256” when exporting):
sign_refused_password: The password is wrong, or the certificate file is damaged.
sign_refused_malformed: This is not a readable PKCS#12 (.p12 or .pfx) file.
sign_refused_no_key: The certificate file has no private key to sign with.
sign_refused_unsupported_key: This key cannot sign here: use an RSA, ECDSA P-256 or ECDSA P-384 key.
sign_refused_encrypted: Signing needs an unencrypted export: a password-protected file cannot be signed here. Choose “No password” under Security to sign.
sign_refused_damaged: The exported file could not be prepared for signing.
export_sign_hint: Approval signature (PAdES-B) with your certificate, added as the last step.
export_sign_needs_certificate: Choose a certificate to sign with.
export_signatures_notice: Existing signatures will not be in the exported file: export writes a new file, and a signature cannot survive that. The original file keeps them.
summary_signature: Signed by {signer} ({algorithm}), field “{field}”: approval signature; identity and trust not verified.

batch_skip_cancelled: Not started: the batch was cancelled

compress_flatten_alpha_hint: Otherwise they are skipped. Flattening changes how they look on coloured backgrounds.
compress_estimate_low: Little to gain: the estimated saving is under 3%. The file is already compact.
compress_no_images: No images to compress; only the lossless pass applies.
compress_result_unchanged: Nothing got smaller, so the original file is kept.
compress_skip_filter_unsupported: CCITT, JBIG2 or JPEG 2000 scan, kept as is
compress_skip_has_alpha: transparent (turn on flattening to include it)
compress_skip_at_target: JPEG already at or below the target resolution
compress_skip_too_large: too large to decode in the browser
announce_compression_applied: {preset} compression will be applied on export
images_pages_hint: Empty for all pages, or e.g. 1-3, 5
images_too_large: {size} px is larger than this browser can draw; choose a lower resolution.
announce_image_copied: Page image copied to the clipboard
compress_result_structure_only: All of it from the file structure: −{lossless}. No image could be made smaller.
tool_redact_tooltip: Redact: mark text or drag an area (Alt drags an area over text)
cmd_redaction_mark_matches: Mark all search matches for redaction

match.countPlural=one: Found {count} possible match of sensitive data
match.countPlural=*: Found {count} possible matches of sensitive data

redaction_honesty: Marks are only marks: the text under them stays in the file, and anyone can remove a mark, until redactions are applied. Applying cannot be undone once the file is exported.
redaction_honesty_short: Marks hide nothing until you apply them.
redaction_no_document_body: Open a PDF to mark content for redaction.
redaction_empty_body: Select text and press X, drag an area with the Redact tool, mark search matches, or find sensitive data.
redaction_include: Include the mark on page {page} when applying
redaction_find_failed: Could not read the text of this document.
redaction_find_none: Nothing found. The helpers look for e-mail addresses, phone numbers, IBANs, Turkish ID numbers, card numbers and dates in the document’s text; scanned pages without text are not searched.
export_redaction_pending_marks: Redaction marks that were not applied are still in the file: apply or delete them, then export again.
redaction_apply_none: Tick at least one mark to apply
redaction_apply_failed: Applying redactions failed; the document is unchanged.

match.countPlural=one: {countText} ticked mark becomes a permanent removal.

redaction_apply_what: The text, images and drawings under them are removed from the file, not covered. Links, notes and form values inside them are deleted, and the text found under them is also removed from bookmarks, metadata and tags.
redaction_apply_irreversible: You can undo this while the document is open. Once the document is exported, it cannot be undone: the removed content is not in the file.

match.countPlural=one: {countText} unticked mark stays a mark; apply or delete it before exporting.
match.countPlural=*: {countText} unticked marks stay marks; apply or delete them before exporting.

redaction_keep_attachments_hint: Attachments are removed by default because their content cannot be searched reliably. Kept attachments are listed as not verified, and applying stops if redacted text can still be seen in them.
redaction_area_only_hint: Only the marked areas are removed. Without this, the text under the marks is also removed from bookmarks, metadata and tags and searched for in the whole file; applying stops if it still appears anywhere, for example unmarked on another page.
redaction_applying: Removing content and running the self-check…
redaction_result_strings: Text replaced in bookmarks, metadata and tags
redaction_result_searched: Strings searched for in the whole file
redaction_include_text: Include mark {index} on page {page} (“{text}”) when applying
redaction_include_index: Include mark {index} on page {page} when applying
redaction_short_hint: Text shorter than 4 characters is removed inside the marks only: the same text elsewhere in the document stays, and nothing checks for it. Tick it to search and scrub it in the whole document too; the apply then stops if it is still visible elsewhere.

match.countPlural=one: {countText} mark that was not applied reached into a removed area, so it was deleted with the content.
match.countPlural=*: {countText} marks that were not applied reached into removed areas, so they were deleted with the content.

redaction_result_skipped: Removed inside the areas only, too short to search the whole document for: {strings}.

match.countPlural=one: The self-check could not decode {count} stream, so it was not searched for redacted content: {groups}.
match.countPlural=*: The self-check could not decode {count} streams, so they were not searched for redacted content: {groups}.

match.countPlural=one: The text of {count} page changed since the search, so its results are hidden. Search again to update them.
match.countPlural=*: The text of {count} pages changed since the search, so their results are hidden. Search again to update them.

redaction_result_tags_pruned: Accessibility tags pruned to match the removed content.
redaction_result_tags_removed: Accessibility tags removed: they could not stay intact, so the file is no longer tagged.
redaction_result_gate: Blank check passed: every area was empty before the fill.
redaction_result_export_note: Export the document to save the redacted file; the export runs the self-check again on the final file.
redaction_check_single_revision: One revision only (no earlier versions kept)
redaction_check_no_search_hits: Redacted text not found by search
redaction_check_object_strings: Redacted text absent from every string and stream
redaction_check_byte_grep: Redacted text absent from the raw bytes
redaction_check_fill_pixels: The areas show only the fill
redaction_blocked_gate: Content was still visible in an area after removal, so nothing was applied. The document is unchanged.
redaction_blocked_forensic: The self-check found redacted content in the result, so nothing was applied. The document is unchanged.
redaction_blocked_hint_search: The redacted text still appears elsewhere. Mark those places too, or choose Area only.
redaction_blocked_hint_attachments: Kept attachments still contain the redacted text. Apply without keeping attachments.

match.countPlural=one: Redaction: {countText} area on {pages}, self-check passed ({checks} checks).
match.countPlural=*: Redaction: {countText} areas on {pages}, self-check passed ({checks} checks).

match.countPlural=one: {count} area on a resized page was not checked by area; its text was still searched for.
match.countPlural=*: {count} areas on resized pages were not checked by area; their text was still searched for.

match.countPlural=one: Text edits: {countText} (fonts renamed: {fonts}, marked-content ids repaired: {mcids}, unused objects removed: {objects}).
match.countPlural=*: Text edits: {countText} (fonts renamed: {fonts}, marked-content ids repaired: {mcids}, unused objects removed: {objects}).

summary_text_edits_fell_back: {countText} fell back from the original font to {faces}

match.countPlural=one: {countText} stream could not be checked for the redacted strings, because its encoding cannot be searched ({groups}).
match.countPlural=*: {countText} streams could not be checked for the redacted strings, because their encoding cannot be searched ({groups}).

summary_filter_undecodable: streams that could not be decoded

match.countPlural=one: {countText} short redacted string (under 4 characters) was removed inside the marked areas only; it was not searched for elsewhere in the document.
match.countPlural=*: {countText} short redacted strings (under 4 characters) were removed inside the marked areas only; they were not searched for elsewhere in the document.

export_progress_redaction: Running the redaction self-check on the final file…
export_failed_redaction: The redaction self-check found redacted content in the exported file, so it is not offered for download.
resize_error_size: Enter a width and height between {min} and {max} {unit}.
resize_match_orientation_hint: Landscape pages get the size turned sideways.
resize_mode_scale_hint: Fills the page at the same proportions; what does not fit is cut off on the side away from the anchor.
resize_stretch: Stretch to fill exactly (distorts the content)
resize_mode_fit_hint: Scales the content to fit inside the page, with margins.
resize_mode_canvas_hint: Keeps the content at 100% and only makes the page larger or smaller around it.
resize_preview_original: {pages} go back to their original size
crop_notice: A crop hides what lies outside the rectangle. The content stays in the file, and any PDF viewer can show it again.
crop_margins_label: Margins to crop, from the page as shown
crop_error_invalid: Enter margins of zero or more.
crop_error_too_small: These margins leave too little of the page.
crop_preview: {pages} will be cropped, the first to {size}
crop_preview_reset: {pages} will show their whole page again
crop_preview_none: Set the margins, drag the edges of the preview or draw a crop area on the page.

match.countPlural=one: {count} blank or image page is left as it is.
match.countPlural=*: {count} blank or image pages are left as they are.

match.countPlural=one: {count} page is too small for these margins and is left as it is.
match.countPlural=*: {count} pages are too small for these margins and are left as they are.

crop_discard: Also remove the content outside the crop (irreversible after export)
crop_discard_hint: Uses the redaction pipeline: text, images, drawings, links and notes outside the crop are removed from the file and the area is painted white, then a self-check verifies nothing is left there.
crop_discard_warning: You can undo this while the document is open. Once the document is exported, the removed content is not in the file and cannot be brought back.

match.countPlural=one: On {count} page, content that another page of the workspace still shows is kept.
match.countPlural=*: On {count} pages, content that other pages of the workspace still show is kept.

match.countPlural=one: {count} redaction mark reaches outside the crop. It will be deleted, not applied: the text under it is removed only where it lies outside the crop. Apply it first to remove all of it.
match.countPlural=*: {count} redaction marks reach outside the crop. They will be deleted, not applied: the text under them is removed only where it lies outside the crop. Apply them first to remove all of it.

crop_preview_resized: {pages} will be cropped, the first to {size} of its original page, which is then resized to {pageSize} again
crop_resized_notice: Resized pages: the margins are measured on the original page, before the resize. The cropped content is then fitted to the new page size again.
crop_removing: Removing the content outside the crop and checking the result…
crop_draw_layer: Draw the crop area on page {page}
crop_draw_hint: Drag a rectangle on a page to set the crop area. Esc cancels.
crop_draw_started: Drawing a crop area. Drag a rectangle on a page, or press Escape to go back.
history_crop_discard: Crop {pages} and remove the content outside
compare_setup_body: Pages are matched, then compared picture by picture and word by word. Changes are shown on the second document.
compare_drop_hint: Drop a PDF here to compare with it.
compare_align_auto_hint: Page by page when the pages line up, by content otherwise
compare_align_index_hint: Page 1 with page 1, page 2 with page 2, …
compare_align_best_hint: Finds inserted, deleted and moved pages by their content
compare_dpi_hint: 150 dpi finds smaller differences and takes longer.
compare_report_failed: The report could not be made: {reason}
compare_stale: The documents changed since this comparison; run it again to compare them as they are now.
compare_missing_in_a: Not in A: inserted in B
compare_heatmap_pending: Heat map (when the comparison is done)
compare_changes_empty_body: Choose two documents and compare them; the changes are listed here.
compare_note_visual: Pixel differences at {dpi} dpi: they show where pages look different, not why; a pixel diff cannot tell intent.
compare_note_text: The text comparison sees only extractable text (scanned pages need OCR first) and depends on the reading order.
compare_note_scope: Neither sees metadata, hidden annotations, scripts, form values that are not drawn, tags or changes that look the same, beyond the details listed.
compare_note_export: Page numbers, watermarks, headers and footers added at export are not compared.
compare_note_assembled: {name} has cropped, resized or added pages, so it was compared as it will be exported, including its page numbers and watermarks.
convert_keep_headers: Keep running headers, footers and page numbers
convert_join_hyphens: Join words hyphenated at line ends
convert_images_zip: Include (a ZIP with document.md and the images)
convert_preview_empty: No text was found on these pages.
convert_note_order: Reading order and headings are reconstructed from positions and font sizes: columns, sidebars, footnotes, tables and rotated text may come out in the wrong order.
convert_note_tables: Tables are not detected: their text follows in reading order.

match.countPlural=one: {count} table-like layout found: tables are not detected, its text follows in reading order.
match.countPlural=*: {count} table-like layouts found: tables are not detected, their text follows in reading order.

match.countPlural=one: {count} running header, footer or page-number line left out.
match.countPlural=*: {count} running header, footer or page-number lines left out.

convert_note_without_text: Pages without extractable text (scans): {pages}. Run OCR first to include them.
ocr_facts_failed: The pages could not be checked: {reason}
ocr_scope_skipped: Blank and image pages are not recognized: they have no PDF page to add text to.
ocr_packs_failed: The languages could not be read: {reason}
ocr_languages_order: Recognized as {languages}; the first language leads.
ocr_download_note: The first run downloads {size} from this site. Nothing is sent anywhere.

match.countPlural=one: {count} page already has text this app recognized earlier: replacing it keeps every word from being found twice.
match.countPlural=*: {count} pages already have text this app recognized earlier: replacing it keeps every word from being found twice.

match.countPlural=one: {count} page has invisible text from another program, often an earlier OCR. It is kept unless you replace it; replacing removes all invisible text on that page.
match.countPlural=*: {count} pages have invisible text from another program, often an earlier OCR. It is kept unless you replace it; replacing removes all invisible text on those pages.

ocr_signed_warning: This document is signed. Recognizing text changes the file, so the export will remove its signatures.
ocr_honesty: Recognized text may contain errors. The page image is unchanged; search and copy use the recognized text, which cannot be edited.

match.totalPlural=one: The document changed: recognizing the changed page again, {doneText} of {totalText}…
match.totalPlural=*: The document changed: recognizing the changed pages again, {doneText} of {totalText}…

ocr_phase_write: Adding the text to the document…
ocr_progress_continues: You can close this: recognition continues and the status bar shows its progress. Nothing changes until every page is done.
ocr_not_applied: The recognized text was not added because the document changed meanwhile. Run it again.
ocr_changed_during_run: The document changed while text was being recognized. Run it again.

match.countPlural=one: The document changed during recognition: {countText} page is recognized again.
match.countPlural=*: The document changed during recognition: {countText} pages are recognized again.

ocr_document_closed: Recognition stopped: its document was closed.
ocr_cancelled: Recognition cancelled. The document is unchanged.
ocr_failed_short: Text recognition failed. The document is unchanged.
ocr_failed: Text recognition failed; the document is unchanged. {reason}

match.countPlural=one: {count} page took too long and was left without text.
match.countPlural=*: {count} pages took too long and were left without text.

match.countPlural=one: {count} large page was read at a lower resolution (40 megapixel limit).
match.countPlural=*: {count} large pages were read at a lower resolution (40 megapixel limit).

ocr_quality_good_explanation: Most words were read with high confidence.
ocr_quality_review_explanation: Some words may be wrong: check the words listed below.
ocr_quality_poor_explanation: Many words may be wrong. A cleaner scan, High quality or another language may help.
ocr_quality_no_text_explanation: No words were recognized on this page.
ocr_section_no_layer: Page {page} has no text recognized by this app.

match.totalPlural=one: Recognizing a changed page again: {doneText} of {totalText}

ocr_languages_intro: Languages come from this site and nowhere else. Each downloads on first use; keep a language available offline to recognize text without a connection.
ocr_languages_loading: Reading the languages on this device…
ocr_pack_offline_failed: The language could not be changed: {reason}
ocr_import_hint: Other languages: import a Tesseract .traineddata or .traineddata.gz file named by its language code, e.g. ukr.traineddata. It stays on this device.
ocr_import_bad_name: The file must be named like a language file, e.g. ukr.traineddata.
ocr_import_not_traineddata: This is not a Tesseract language file.
ocr_import_failed: The file could not be imported: {reason}

match.countPlural=one: Recognized text (OCR) on {countText} page: {languages}. It is invisible text over the unchanged page image.
match.countPlural=*: Recognized text (OCR) on {countText} pages: {languages}. It is invisible text over the unchanged page images.
